title: Joomla Extension - vi-solutions - Open redirects in data view controller and after form submission in Visforms…
description: The Joomla vi-solutions extension contains open redirect vulnerabilities in its data view controller and after form submissions in the Visforms extension versions 1.0.0-5.6.4 and 6.0.0-6.2.1. These vulnerabilities arise because return and redirect URLs are taken from user input without validation, allowing attackers to redirect users to external, potentially malicious sites.
